_readme: Add your gigs to the list below. Each one needs a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a venue; town, time and ticketUrl are optional. Dates in the past disappear from the site automatically, and the list sorts itself soonest-first, so you can just add to the bottom.

_example.note: optional - a line about what makes the night different
_example.infoUrl: optional - a page on this site with the full details; wins over ticketUrl
